items.headline: Hormuz me 2 tanker dhamakon se band
items.detail: Budhwar raat Hormuz Strait me 2 supertanker dhamakon ke baad band ho gaye — IRGC ke mutabik dono me 40 lakh barrel se zyada tel tha aur ve 'bina anumati' wale raste par ja rahe the; dhamake ki wajah abhi saaf nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz Strait duniya ke tel vyapar ka sabse mahatvapurna rasta hai — energy suraksha ke liye ahem.

items.headline: Nvidia: CEO Huang ko hatane par board
items.detail: Nvidia ke board ne CEO Jensen Huang ko hatane par vichaar shuru kiya — WSJ ke mutabik do sambandhon ke baad board ne unke bhavishya par faisla lene ke liye baithak bulayi; khabar ke baad Nvidia ke share lagbhag 8% gire.
items.exam_angle: AI chip kshetra me corporate governance aur America-China tech takraar — arthvyavastha aur antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: G7: Taiwan ke paas China ki harkat khatra
items.detail: G7 videsh mantriyon ne Paris me sanyukt ghoshna me kaha, Taiwan ke poorv me China ki badhti harkatein kshetriya sthirata aur samudri aazadi ke liye khatra hain; China ne June se wahan coast guard gasht badhai hai.
items.exam_angle: Taiwan Strait aur Indo-Pacific me shakti santulan — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Nepal: van khaai me giri, 10 ki maut
items.detail: Chhath ke liye Kathmandu se Sarlahi ja rahi electric van Makwanpur me sadak se lagbhag 500 meter neeche gir gayi; 10 ki maut hui aur kai ghayal hue, haadse ki jaanch jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Padosi desh Nepal me sadak suraksha aur apda prabandhan — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Israel cabinet: Iran hamle ki taiyaari badhao
items.detail: Israel ki suraksha cabinet ne sena ko Iran par sambhav hamle ki taiyaari badhane ka nirdesh diya, KAN ne bataya; vipaksh neta Eisenkot ne nayi sarkar banne tak bina turant khatre ke sainya karwai se mana kiya.
items.exam_angle: Israel-Iran takraav aur West Asia ki suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: China: Nvidia jasusi daave America ki 'nakabandi' chaal
items.detail: China ne kaha America Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang par jasusi ke aaropon ko China par takniki 'nakabandi' lagane ke bahane ke roop me istemal kar raha hai; Beijing ne aaropon ko be-buniyad batakar khariz kiya, jabki Nvidia ne swatantra jaanch shuru ki hai.
items.exam_angle: America-China takniki yuddh aur AI chip pratibandh — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Mississippi se 1874 ke baad pehle Black senator
items.detail: Democrat Scott Colom ne Mississippi Senate chunav me Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith ko lagbhag 4,600 voton se haraya; ve 1874 ke baad rajya ke pehle Black senator bane aur 1982 ke baad pehle Democrat senator.
items.exam_angle: America ke midterm chunav aur nagrik adhikar itihas — antarrashtriya rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump-Netanyahu me Iran par takraar
items.detail: Israeli media ke mutabik hafte ke ant me phone par Trump aur Netanyahu ke beech Iran par yuddh phir shuru karne ko lekar tez behes hui, ek sutra ne ise 'shouting match from hell' kaha; Netanyahu ke karyalaya ne ise 'fake news' batakar khariz kiya, jabki Trump ne kaha abhi dobara hamla zaroori nahi lagta.
items.exam_angle: America-Israel sambandh aur Iran par yuddh ki sambhavna — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: SS United States dooba, sabse bada reef
items.detail: Duniya ka sabse tez samudri jahaz SS United States Florida ke paas janboojhkar duboya gaya — 990 foot lamba jahaz ab duniya ka sabse bada kritrim reef banega, gotaakhoro ke liye 12 November se khulega.
items.exam_angle: Samudri paryavaran aur kritrim reef — paryavaran ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Okaloosa County Tourist Development Dept (Public domain)

items.headline: Kushner-Witkoff guruvaar ko Putin se milenge
items.detail: America ke doot Jared Kushner aur Steve Witkoff guruvaar ko Moscow me Rashtrapati Putin se milenge; Axios ke mutabik ve Russia se Europe ke saath naye suraksha samjhote ka prastav mangenge aur agle daur ki vaarta me Europe ki bhagidari par zor denge, phir Dublin me Zelensky se milenge.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine shanti vaarta aur Europe ki suraksha vyavastha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Nasser aspatal par hamla, 6 ki maut
items.detail: Khan Younis ke Nasser Medical Complex par subah-subeh Israeli hawai hamle me kam se kam 6 log mare gaye, jinme ek surgeon bhi hain, aur 20 se zyada ghayal hue; Israeli sena ne kaha usne Hamas ke Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abu Ismail ko nishana banaya. [Sudhara gaya — pehle 4 ki maut batayi gayi thi.]
items.exam_angle: Gaza yuddh-viram aur West Asia tanav — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Pope Leo XIV Peru pahunche, ghar wapsi
items.detail: Pope Leo XIV budhwar ko Peru pahunche — apni dakshin America yatra ka aakhri charan; ve wahan 20 saal se zyada missionary aur Chiclayo ke bishop rahe, aur chhah din me Lima, Chiclayo, Cusco aur Amazon ka daura karenge.

items.headline: Brooklyn me imarat giri: 2 ki maut
items.detail: New York ke Brooklyn ke Flatbush me budhwar shaam ek 3-manzila imarat paas ki khudai wali jagah me gir gayi; kam se kam 2 ki maut aur 17 ghayal hue, jinme 4 gambhir aur 7 bachche hain; malbe me fase logon ki talash jaari hai, lagbhag 250 damkalkarmi lage hain. [Sudhara gaya — pehle 1 maut aur 12 ghayal bataye gaye the.]
items.exam_angle: Shahri suraksha aur imarat niyam — nagar prashasan aur apda prabandhan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America me Russia ke rajdut Darchiev ka nidhan
items.detail: America me Russia ke rajdut Alexander Darchiev ka 66 saal ki umr me Moscow me achanak nidhan ho gaya, Russia ke videsh mantralaya ne budhwar ko bataya; ve March 2025 se is pad par the aur lambe samay se beemar the.
items.exam_angle: Russia-America sambandh — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: COP31: Iran ne yuddh nuksan ka muawza manga
items.detail: COP31 me Iran ke Rashtrapati Pezeshkian ne kaha ki America aur Israel ke hamlo se hue paryavaran nuksan ka muawza milna chahiye, aur yuddh ke samay ki zimmedari ko jalvayu pratibaddhataon se joda jana chahiye.
items.exam_angle: Jalvayu sammelan aur yuddh ka paryavaran prabhav — COP31 ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Brazil ne Facebook par $1.3M jurmana lagaya
items.detail: Brazil ki chunav adalat ne Meta ke Facebook par 7.5 million reais (lagbhag $1.3 million) ka jurmana lagaya, kyunki usne pichle mahine ke rashtrapati chunav ke dauran adalat ke aadeshon ka poori tarah palan nahi kiya; adalat ne kaha chunav ko janbujhkar prabhavit karne ka saboot abhi nahi mila.
items.exam_angle: Social media aur chunav aachar sanhita — chunav me platform ki bhoomika.

items.headline: Storm Charles: Portugal me sab band
items.detail: Atlantic toofan Charles ke aane par Portugal me lagbhag 8,000 school band rahe aur 300 se zyada udanein radd hui; 120 km/h se zyada ki hawa chali, lekin bada nuksan nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Charam mausam aur jalvayu parivartan — COP31 ke dauraan ka mahatvapurna mudda.

items.headline: Indonesia ke uprashtrapati Gibran ne istifa diya
items.detail: Indonesia ke uprashtrapati Gibran Rakabuming Raka ne budhwar ko Rashtrapati Prabowo Subianto ko apna istifa saunp diya; Supreme Court ne unka shiksha samkakshata praman-patra radd kar diya tha aur 120 sansadon ne mahabhiyog ki prakriya shuru ki thi. Istifa sweekar hua ya nahi, abhi spasht nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Indonesia ki rajneeti aur samvaidhanik yogyata — dakshin-poorv Asia ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: 4 EU desh Merz ki shart ke khilaf
items.detail: Slovakia, Czech Republic, Hungary aur Bulgaria ne Germany ke Chancellor Friedrich Merz ki shart ko thukra diya — ve EU ke agle saat saal ke budget ki manzoori ko Ukraine ko nayi madad se jodne ke khilaf hain; Slovakia ke PM Fico ne ise 'blackmail' kaha aur veto ki dhamki di.
items.exam_angle: EU ki rajneeti aur Ukraine ko madad — antarrashtriya sangathan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Riyadh ki taraf 3 Houthi missile girayi gayi
items.detail: Saudi netritva wale gathbandhan ne budhwar ko Riyadh ki ore aayi teen Houthi cruise missile ko hawa me hi nasht kar diya; koi nuksan ya hatahat ki khabar nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Yemen-Saudi sangharsh aur tel suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Abu Dhabi vaarta khatm, safalta nahi
items.detail: America ki madhyasthata wali Abu Dhabi vaarta do din baad khatm hui; badi kaidi adla-badli par sahmati bani, lekin yuddh-viram ya seema par koi safalta nahi mili; Kushner aur Witkoff ab Putin se milne Moscow jayenge.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh aur shanti vaarta — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran: Europe ke US base bhi nishane par
items.detail: Iran ke suraksha pramukh Mohsen Rezaei ne kaha, America ne phir hamla kiya to Europe me sthit US sainya base bhi nishana banenge; unhone samriddh uranium desh se bahar na bhejne ki baat bhi dohrai.
items.exam_angle: West Asia me tanav aur America-Iran takraav — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Italy: farzi bomb dhamki se 300 school khali
items.detail: Italy ke lagbhag 6,300 schoolon ko email par farzi bomb ki dhamki mili, jiske baad kam se kam 300 school khali karaye gaye; Scotland aur Northern Ireland me bhi aisi dhamki mili, lekin wahan koi khatra nahi mana gaya aur koi visfotak nahi mila.
items.exam_angle: Europe me hybrid warfare aur cyber-suraksha — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Kohat me hamla: 10 police shaheed
items.detail: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ke Kohat me avaidh sone ki khanan ke khilaf operation se laut rahi police team par hamla hua; DSP Haidar Zaman samet 10 police karmchari shaheed hue, 18 hamlaawar bhi maare gaye.
items.exam_angle: Pakistan me aatankwad aur suraksha sthiti — padosi desh ke halaat, antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.
